summary: Verified the 4 combo/system-slip changes end-to-end. BACKEND (4/4 + 1 skipped): GET /api/systems returns {week, systems:[…]} where every system.selections leg carries `banker` (bool) and `league` (str). Across the current 8 system slips there are 54 legs — 49 with a non-empty league, 20 flagged banker=true. GET /api/tips exposes 12 parlays with 55 total legs — 51 legs carry per-leg `league` (backfilled by enrich_member_picks), and `live` legs also carry `live_score`/`live_minute` keys (annotated by live_annotate_sync). POST /api/tips/{id}/share-image returns {path}, and GET /api/files/{path} returns a valid WebP image (RIFF/WEBP magic bytes, >500 bytes). The endpoint correctly rejects hq-auto/smart tips with 400. FRONTEND: (a) 'View AI System Picks' tab renders 8 system-cards, 54 [data-testid$='-leg'] legs, 20 [data-testid='system-banker-badge'] cyan BANKER chips, 49 trophy icons next to league names — matches API exactly. (b) 'View Live Picks' shows 9 tips including a 4-game parlay; each single-game live pick has its own RED 'LIVE {minute}\' {home}-{away}' score header, and the parlay's legs each show 'Live now' kickoff badges via the isKickoffLive fallback (leg.live_score is not populated for those legs today but the code path is safe). (c) 'View Community Picks' renders. (d) Rate Wall tab loads with 3 [data-testid^='play-slip-'] play buttons. NO console errors on any tab. Regression: header/nav intact, all 5 tabs (AI Single-Game, Smart Picks, Scorers, System, Community, Live, Settled) switch cleanly. shareSlip.js confirmed to use ONLY discreet text 'Kombi-Schein · Gesamtquote {odds} · @{username}' — no 'Post it. Rate it. Cash it.' slogan.

integration_issues.issue: Only 1/55 parlay legs currently carry live_score in DB (see /api/tips inspection). For the visible 4-game parlay on Live Picks, none of the 4 legs had leg.live+leg.live_score populated even though the individual matches are live — the [data-testid=leg-live-score-{li}] chip therefore does not render for that tip. The React code path is correct and falls back to the 'Live now' kickoff pill without error. Suggest verifying live_annotate_sync propagates live_score/live_minute onto EACH member-parlay leg (currently seems to only run for member-single tips or a subset).

action_items: OPTIONAL: extend live_annotate_sync to also enrich EACH leg of a member PARLAY tip with live_score/live_minute so the per-leg red score badge (data-testid=leg-live-score-*) renders on combo tips too — right now only 1/55 combo legs carry this data and the visible 4-game live parlay falls back to 'Live now' pills.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 9583 lines. The share-image code path (~L3099), _render_slip_image (~L1973), snapshot_systems (~L5640), and live_annotate_sync (~L8862) all live in one monolith — modularization is overdue (split into ticket_render.py / snapshots.py / live_annotate.py).

share-image endpoint caches the rendered image via tip.share_image_path but skips the cache for tip.status=='live' (correct — score can change). However each live-parlay share still re-fetches /fixtures?live=all which is a 20+ league scan; consider caching the live_info per tip_id for ~30s to avoid rate-limit pressure.

RateWall.jsx line 940 renders leg-live-score ONLY when `leg.live && leg.live_score` — a truthy string check ('') would exclude an empty score. Fine, but the fallback branch (line 943) requires `leg.status !== 'live'` — meaning a leg with status='live' but NO live_score will show NEITHER the red score chip NOR the 'Live now' fallback. This is a hidden state gap. Recommend: `leg.live && leg.live_score ? SCORE_CHIP : (leg.status==='live' || isKickoffLive) ? LIVE_NOW_CHIP : KICKOFF_CHIP`.

shareSlip.js — discreet text is good, but on Telegram fallback (L28) it still appends the image URL as the primary `url` param which effectively IS a CTA/link. If the goal is 'no link spam', consider dropping url= for the Telegram fallback and only sending text (t.me/share/msg?text=...).

success_rate.backend: 100% (4 passed / 1 skipped — skip is only when no hq-auto tip exists)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — Systems tab shows all 54 legs with league + 20 banker badges; Live tab shows per-tip live scores; no console errors; discreet share text confirmed in shareSlip.js

context_for_next_testing_agent: The share-image endpoint's file magic-byte check (RIFF/WEBP) is a reliable indicator that PIL rendered correctly. To visually verify the DISCREET branding (top-left 'tipjarglobal.com', no QR, no slogan, BANKER cyan chips, per-leg red live score, league line), download the file returned by /api/files/{path} and inspect. The Systems tab is the canonical place bankers appear (20 badges currently). Member combo tips can have banker legs only if the tipster created them from the /systems tab (snapshot_systems marks them at snapshot time). For the leg-live-score per-parlay-leg feature, live_annotate_sync would need to be verified to write live_score/live_minute onto EACH leg of a parlay — right now only 1/55 combo legs carry that data.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 4 requested changes are correctly implemented at the backend and rendered by the frontend. The single edge case (parlay legs without live_score even when the underlying match is live) is data/enrichment-level, not a rendering bug — the code path is defensive and falls back to 'Live now' pills without erroring.
